Outline

New revision available.

Study materials and evidence boundary

This is a working research presentation. Published sources remain linked to their original public pages where available. The study model, draft review protocols and candidate literature register are unpublished working materials; their original files are not included in this public edition. Some cited workshop documents are locally held and are also not distributed here; their original citation metadata is retained.

Participant-level consultation records, transcript locators and identifying role/date combinations are withheld. The public presentation retains the recorded model structure, source-contribution counts, support status and review-depth assessments. Those counts and assessments describe the original working ledger, include withheld contributions and have not been recomputed after redaction. They are not independent-study counts or causal validation.

Candidate references retain their provisional screening and reading-depth labels. This edition omits raw abstract-export fields. The planned reviews and hypotheses remain distinct from completed or independently verified findings.

Source figures retain their original attribution and the recorded CC BY-NC 4.0 licence. Fonts are requested from the viewer’s device; no font binaries are distributed.
